Fiscal year 2026
revenue increased 111% to $14.8 million, compared to $7.0 million in fiscal year 2025, driven by accelerating demand for the Company’s software-defined GPU-as-a-Service platform.

Successfully completed business combination with D. Boral ARC Acquisition I Corp.; commenced trading on Nasdaq under ticker symbols “XLAB” and “XLABW” for its Class A common stock and its warrants, respectively, on August 28, 2026.

Expanded strategic partnerships, including an LOI with Compal Electronics for next-generation 800 VDC GPU validation platforms and an MOU with EnergyBank for floating offshore wind-powered AI compute.
